risk_note: CT-13e (C-31 step 2, analytics event storage; 编排 D10-1487 / D10-1488 / D10-1489 / D10-1492). Only db/migrations/0140_analytics-events.sql (D10-1494 改号: renamed from 0141, content unchanged — the gate wants the next free, contiguous number and CT-13e lands before B1-34q; the only test change is the migration number in a comment on line 1 of test/spec/db/events/kit.ts; mechanical, review rounds not reopened) plus the regenerated db/schema.sql and packages/db/src/db.gen.ts (pnpm db:snapshot on this Mac via Colima + OPS-lane/pg18-shim, D10-1492). app.events: RANGE (server_at) per +08:00 day + DEFAULT, columns per 04 §3.2 plus event_id / event_type / app_id; no unique key on the partitioned table; global dedup in the unpartitioned app.event_dedup, PRIMARY KEY (event_type, event_id) (D10-1488 option 1; the write path is CT-13g).
